welcome.mini.clipEmpty: The story you save goes here
welcome.welcome.title: Welcome to Deckle
welcome.welcome.lede: A morning paper for your e-reader, printed on your own computer. And the books you own, finished like the store's.
welcome.welcome.body: Four short pages: your paper and when it prints, the bookmarklet that saves what you're reading into it, the back pages and the extras, and where everything else is.
welcome.welcome.noServer: Nothing goes through a server. There's no account to make.
welcome.paper.title: Your paper
welcome.paper.body: Every morning Deckle builds a newspaper: the weather, local news, your feeds and the articles you saved, whole and with their photos.
welcome.paper.none: There's no paper yet. Set one up to start with the weather and local news for your town; you'll name the town on the Daily tab.
welcome.paper.ready: Your paper is set up. The Daily tab has its town, feeds and sections.
welcome.save.title: Save to paper
welcome.save.body: Reading something you'd rather finish on the Kindle? A bookmarklet is a bookmark that does something: click it and the page you're on is in tomorrow's paper.
welcome.save.needsSchedule: The bookmarklets work while the morning schedule is on.
welcome.save.try: Try it: open any article in your browser and click Save to paper.
welcome.extras.title: The back pages
welcome.extras.puzzles: Every paper ends the way a paper should. The Mini, a 5×5 crossword whose theme answers are yesterday's headlines; a word search hiding more of them; a word ladder; an almanac with sunrise, the moon, the usual first frost and tonight's meteor shower; a horoscope; and On this day. Yesterday's answers print the next morning, and a Kindle that keeps notes marks yours: write the answer as a note on the clue and the paper says how many you solved.
welcome.extras.puzzleBooks: Puzzle books to write on. Crosswords with your own words and clues, word searches, sudoku, word ladders, cryptograms, nonograms and mazes, as a book that takes pen ink on a Kindle Scribe or a reMarkable. The Puzzles tab makes one in a minute.
welcome.extras.shelf: From Your Shelf. The books you're in the middle of, a past highlight and the words you looked up this week, read from your own Kindle, on this computer only.
welcome.extras.ai: An AI model, if you want one. Off by default. Turned on, it folds the same story from several feeds into one, writes short section briefs, and gives your books X-Ray descriptions and chapter recaps. It can run on this {machine} for free through Ollama, with nothing leaving it, or at a service you pay.
welcome.where.title: Where things are
welcome.where.daily: Your town, feeds and interests; the sections in print order; and Delivery: a Kindle by USB or email, a Kobo, a PocketBook, a reMarkable, or any folder.
welcome.where.books: Drop in EPUBs, Word documents and PDFs; plug in the Kindle; press Send. They come out like store books.
welcome.where.cookbook: The recipes you save, as one book that keeps up with itself.
welcome.where.puzzles: A puzzle book to write on, seven kinds, sent to the Scribe or saved for a reMarkable.
welcome.where.kindle: What's on it, how far you are, and what Deckle can make better.
welcome.where.ai: Off, on this {machine}, or a service online, for X-Ray, chapter recaps and the paper's editor.
welcome.where.again: This welcome is under Settings → About if you want it again.
schedule.web: The container prints the paper on its schedule, and its watcher is always on.
schedule.off: Off. Nothing prints until it's on.
schedule.noWatcher: Every morning at {time}, but the watcher isn't installed. Turn the schedule on again.
schedule.on: Every morning at {time}. The watcher that delivers it, and takes what you save, runs from login.
bookmarklet.paper.name: Save to paper
bookmarklet.paper.what: On any article, it puts the story in tomorrow's paper, whole, with its photos.
bookmarklet.recipe.name: Save recipe
bookmarklet.recipe.what: On a recipe page, it sends the recipe to your cookbook, taken from the page you're looking at, so it works on sites that won't let Deckle fetch them.
bookmarklet.web.one: Drag it to your bookmarks bar. If a drag won't take, Copy it, make a new bookmark and paste it as the address.
bookmarklet.web.both: Drag each to your bookmarks bar. If a drag won't take, Copy one, make a new bookmark and paste it as the address.
bookmarklet.desk.one: The install page opens in your browser; drag it to the bookmarks bar there. They work while Deckle's morning schedule is on.
bookmarklet.desk.both: The install page opens in your browser; drag each to the bookmarks bar there. They work while Deckle's morning schedule is on.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.note: The app's own words. The paper and your books keep their own language.
settings.language.draft: Each translation starts as an AI draft that readers correct.
daily.run.notSentNote: These wait in the outbox and go with the next push.
daily.run.missedKindle: This paper didn't reach your Kindle. It waits in the outbox and goes with the next push.
daily.run.missedReader: This paper didn't reach your Kobo or PocketBook. It waits in the outbox and goes with the next push.
